notes.title: Patch v1.2
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Adjusted several cameras in the old farm to provide a better playing experience
[*] Fixed some instances of the player being able to leave the viewable area in certain locations
[*] Fixed the player's control returning too early when interacting with the doll
[*] Added the ability to display the controls during gameplay
[*] Skipping cutscenes now requires the player to hold the action key
[/list]
